newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares rebound after three-day losses.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares rebound after three-day losses.

text.p: Slovenian shares rebounded on Tuesday after three days of losses, with the index boosted by gains in market heavyweights BTC and Kolinska.
But traders said continued uncertainty on the market would likely keep price moves confined to narrow ranges.
* The SBI index firmed 0.37 percent or 4.81 points to 1,302.60.
* Food maker Kolinska was the most active share, firming 0.37 percent to 1,907 shares on volume of 7,040 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
